skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply economic theories and models to analyze and evaluate economic and business policies in practice.
Develop independent research skills, work in teams, and present findings effectively.
Collect, analyze, and interpret data using both qualitative and quantitative methods.
Identify and solve complex economic issues at micro and macro levels.
Write comprehensive research reports and defend them in presentations.
Manage time effectively to meet deadlines and complete tasks.
Work collaboratively with peers and mentors to complete research projects.
Adhere to ethical standards in research and professional conduct.
